+# Original expressions and their named equations
+
+## Abstract
+
+Expression naming and unrestricted mixed native soundness
+
+Source is the algebra of finite ordered Boolean trees. Pairing is its actual constructor, and rho is the interpreted native substitution. MixedExpr uses fixed ground trees, fixed natural powers of original variables, and pairing. A positive presentation is a finite list of pairs of these expressions. The list may be empty or contain repetitions. X retains every original variable, including unused variables; X may be Fin d, also when d is zero. No tree size or depth bound is imposed.
+
+**Definition 1.1 (Disjoint input and auxiliary namespaces).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Name`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Name` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Name X is X plus MixedExpr X. Inputs are injected on the left and expression names on the right. Every repeated use of an expression has the same auxiliary name. This namespace itself is not finite: the finite lowering emits only the definitions needed by the supplied finite expressions. The finite presentation below restricts this namespace to the names read by the lowering and all declared inputs.
+
+**Definition 1.2 (Name an original expression).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.root`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.root` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+root injects an expression into the auxiliary namespace without changing its variables or ground parameters.
+
+**Definition 1.3 (Expand ground parameters into finite native syntax).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.groundDefinitions`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.groundDefinitions` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+A Boolean leaf has its primitive rank zero or one. A pair recursively includes both ground definitions and the pairing equation for their roots. This operation terminates by recursion on the supplied finite ground tree.
+
+**Definition 1.4 (Lower every expression constructor).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.definitions`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.definitions` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+A residual occurrence rho to power a of x becomes a shift from the original input name x to its expression root. A pair includes the definitions of its two children and an ordinary native pairing equation between their roots. Repeated definitions are retained.
+
+**Definition 1.5 (Retain all positive equalities).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.flatten`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.flatten` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For each original pair of expressions, flatten concatenates both lists of definitions and an equality between the two expression roots. This is a concrete terminating function on the original syntax. It does not assume that the original positive equations already hold.
+
+**Definition 1.6 (Evaluate every named subexpression at the same source assignment).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.extend`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.extend` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+extend keeps the input assignment on the left and evaluates the named expression on the right. No new choice of original source is made.
+
+**Theorem 1.7 (Exact lowering at the original assignment).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.flatten_exact`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.flatten_exact` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+All original positive expression equalities hold at v if and only if every emitted named equation holds at extend v. For the forward direction, ground recursion verifies both primitive leaves and actual native pairs; expression recursion verifies each fixed power and each ordered pair. The reverse direction reads the emitted root equality for every supplied comparison. Unused input values remain those of v.
+
+**Theorem 1.8 (Finite canonical branches from original expression syntax).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.expression_branch_exact`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.expression_branch_exact` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The original expression equalities hold exactly when one member of branches(flatten E) holds on the actual canonical encodings of extend v. The concrete lowering theorem supplies the native named equations. The existing exact constructor-case theorem then chooses ordinary or collapse cases from those same actual values. This finite branch list does not enumerate scalar ranks or native sources, and still retains code equations rather than unrestricted image charts.
+
+**Theorem 1.9 (Expand arbitrary ambient branch solutions).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.flatten_expansion_sound`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.flatten_expansion_sound` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For any selected branch of flatten E, let u assign arbitrary finite ambient codes to names and satisfy that branch's code equations. Then expanding u on the original input names satisfies every original expression equality. Induction through the definitions identifies each expanded auxiliary value with evaluation of its original expression. Existing branch soundness supplies interpreted shifts, ordinary pairs, and the primitive collapse recurrence. Normality and injectivity of expansion are not premises. In particular an ordinary pair of consecutive primitive ranks may collapse after filling without invalidating its native pairing equation.
+
+**Definition 1.10 (Names read by one native equation).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.equationNames`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.equationNames` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+List every input name of the equation, including its output. Repeated names are retained.
+
+**Definition 1.11 (Finite support with the entire original tuple).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.nameSupport`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.nameSupport` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For d original inputs, concatenate every inl(i), i in Fin d, with all names read by flatten E, and deduplicate this finite list. Auxiliary expressions are identified by their actual syntax. No input is removed when it is absent from the equations.
+
+**Definition 1.12 (The actual finite carrier).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.FiniteName`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.FiniteName` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+FiniteName E is the subtype of Name(Fin d) belonging to nameSupport E. It contains all declared inputs and every auxiliary name used by a lowered equation.
+
+**Definition 1.13 (Embed every original component).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.inputName`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.inputName` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+inputName E i is the original input name in the finite carrier. Its underlying name is inl(i), so distinct original components remain distinct, including unused components.
+
+**Definition 1.14 (Present the actual finite carrier to the unifier).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.namePresentation`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.namePresentation` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Use the deduplicated support list's explicit equivalence with its finite index interval and transport the existing finPresentation. This constructs the code and inverse decoder from the actual supplied finite syntax, without a default element or an assumed presentation of an infinite namespace.
+
+**Definition 1.15 (Reindex every lowered equation).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.finiteEquations`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.finiteEquations` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Each name in an equation of flatten E has a proof of support membership. Reindex that equation by the corresponding subtype elements, retaining the original list order and all repeated equations.
+
+**Definition 1.16 (Restrict the same actual named assignment).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.finiteExtend`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.finiteExtend` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+finiteExtend E v reads extend v at the underlying supported name. In particular its value at inputName E i is v(i). Exact finite lowering and the existing native branch reduction supply a successful total MGU and its factorization at every supported name.
+
+Finite scalar guards and native templates.
+
+**Definition 1.17 (Affine natural rank atoms).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Scalar`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Scalar` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+A scalar is a fixed natural constant, or n(i)+a for a natural parameter n(i) and a fixed natural offset a. Thus its integer interpretation is affine, with coefficient zero or one.
+
+Read a scalar parameter. Scalar.value evaluates the constant or the parameter with its fixed offset in the natural numbers.
+
+**Definition 1.18 (Finite mixed ambient syntax).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Pattern`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Pattern` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+A pattern is an explicit scalar leaf, a residual native block of sort i with a fixed natural offset a, or a pair of patterns. Different residual sorts receive independently supplied native values. Equal values across different sorts are permitted.
+
+**Definition 1.19 (Decorate exactly the actual shape leaves).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Decoration`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Decoration` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Decoration k m s is defined recursively on the supplied free-shape term s. An explicit primitive leaf carries a Scalar k. A residual leaf carries an element of Fin m and a fixed natural offset. A pair carries the decorations of its two children. Empty scalar or native dimensions therefore require no nonexistent selector when the corresponding leaves are absent.
+
+**Definition 1.20 (Construct every named mixed pattern).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.assemble`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.assemble` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+assemble traverses the actual free-shape term with its dependent decoration: explicit leaves become scalar patterns, residual occurrences become shifted native blocks, and binary nodes become pairs. A named family s and decorations d thus give the concrete pattern of every original and auxiliary name. Shared names reuse the same supplied term and decoration.
+
+Assemble ambient codes before expansion. Scalar leaves become primitive codes; a residual block becomes shiftCode a (encode (z i)); pairs become raw ambient pairs. Pair assembly uses no smart normalization and adds no normality test.
+
+Return the established native mixed syntax. A constant scalar becomes a fixed ground tree; a parameter scalar becomes the ranked residual rho to power a of T(n i); a block becomes rho to power a of z i; pairs remain actual native pairs. These are RankedExpr templates, using the existing rankedEval interpretation. Structural recursion proves that expanding Pattern.code is exactly rankedEval of this template.
+
+**Definition 1.21 (A finite conjunction of affine integer equalities).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Guard`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.Guard` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Guard is a list of pairs of scalar atoms. It has no native parameter fields.
+
+The arithmetic domain. Each scalar pair is required to have equal integer values. Its arguments range over all natural scalar tuples. No positivity, shape, disequality, source bound, or normality predicate on residual native values occurs in this guard.
+
+**Definition 1.22 (Extract scalar equalities from matching decorated syntax).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.compare`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.compare` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Two scalar leaves emit their affine equality. Two blocks succeed exactly when their residual sort and fixed offset agree syntactically, emitting no arithmetic condition. Two pairs recursively compare corresponding children and concatenate their guards. All other constructor combinations fail. Success is a sufficient symbolic comparison; no completeness of this procedure over arbitrary native equalities is asserted. In particular accidental equal native parameters are allowed, while the procedure need not recognize every equality caused by them.
+
+Translate explicit ranks. A fixed natural shift adds its offset to constants and parameter offsets.
+
+Translate every ambient leaf. Translation recursively shifts explicit scalar leaves and adds the supplied shift to every residual block offset. Pair structure is preserved. Its assembled code equals shiftCode of the unshifted assembled code.
+
+**Definition 1.23 (Extract every selected branch comparison).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.branchComparisons`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.branchComparisons` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Primitive equations compare the assigned output pattern with their fixed scalar. Shift equations compare the output with syntactic translation of the input; ordinary equations compare it with a raw pair; equalities compare their two named patterns. A collapse uses a supplied scalar atom c(b) and emits all three equations: left rank value(c(b))+1, right rank value(c(b)), and output rank value(c(b))+2. The same scalar is shared in those three comparisons.
+
+**Definition 1.24 (Combine a finite comparison family).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.collect`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.collect` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+collect recursively runs compare on every pattern pair and concatenates the resulting scalar guards. Failure discards the attempted decorated syntax. Success proves all ambient comparisons for every native filling satisfying the combined scalar guard.
+
+**Theorem 1.25 (Unrestricted native soundness of extracted guards).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.guarded_mixed_sound`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.guarded_mixed_sound` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Take any actual finite branch B of the lowered original expressions, any named free-shape family s, a dependent decoration d of every actual shape leaf, and an assignment c of scalar atoms to collapse equations. If collect succeeds on every comparison extracted from B, then for every natural tuple n satisfying its returned affine guard and every arbitrary native tuple z, the original expressions are equal at the outputs rankedEval n z (assemble(s(inl x),d(inl x))). Scalar comparisons give equal primitive ranks. Matching residual blocks have identical shifts of the same encoded native parameter. Matching pairs reconstruct equal ambient codes. The three collapse comparisons provide their explicit natural rank. Existing arbitrary-code branch expansion then proves the original native equations. The hypotheses are finite syntactic comparison success and the extracted scalar equations, rather than a hypothesis asserting the desired original native equalities.
+
+**Definition 1.26 (Enumerate explicit leaves of the actual free shape).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.scalarAddresses`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.scalarAddresses` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+An explicit primitive contributes its empty address, a residual variable contributes none, and a pair prefixes false or true to its two lists of addresses. This enumeration traverses the total MGU term of every supported name.
+
+**Definition 1.27 (Read a rank at an actual code address).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.rankAt`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.rankAt` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Read the primitive rank at the specified subtree address, with zero as a total fallback. The extraction theorem proves that the fallback is excluded for every enumerated explicit MGU leaf.
+
+**Definition 1.28 (Named scalar and collapse coordinates).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.RankSlot`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.RankSlot` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+An explicit slot retains its name and ordered address. A collapse slot retains its output, left input and right input. Slots distinguish positions while repeated uses of a named value keep that same actual value.
+
+**Definition 1.29 (Construct the finite scalar-coordinate list).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.rankSlots`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.rankSlots` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Traverse the presentation's entire name enumeration and every explicit leaf of its total MGU term, then append one slot for each occurrence of a collapse equation in the actual branch. Residual blocks contribute no scalar slot. Empty lists and zero scalar dimensions retain their ordinary meanings.
+
+Read each coordinate from actual canonical codes. An explicit slot reads its named subtree's primitive rank. A collapse slot reads the primitive rank of its right input, the same r shared by all three collapse equations.
+
+**Definition 1.30 (Extract the natural tuple automatically).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.rankParameters`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Arith/FibonacciAtomic/Observer/Constructor/NativeMixedImageConstruction.rankParameters` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+

+/-! Native expression lowering and unrestricted ambient template comparison. -/
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
+
+namespace D5.S3.Arith.FibonacciAtomic.Observer.NativeMixedImageConstruction
+open GenealogicalFiberTransport (Source substitution)
+open NativePrefixIdentityReflection (MixedExpr eval)
+open NativeUniformResidualRealization (RankedExpr rankedEval)
+open NativeFiniteNormalInversion (Code expand encode shiftCode)
+open NativePositiveBranchReduction (Equation BranchEquation)
+variable {X : Type}
+
+/-- Inputs and expression names occupy disjoint namespaces. -/
+abbrev Name (X : Type) := X ⊕ MixedExpr X
+def root (e : MixedExpr X) : Name X := .inr e
+
+/-- Ground trees are expanded into their actual finite native constructors. -/
+def groundDefinitions : Source → List (Equation (Name X))
+  | .of true => [.primitive (root (.ground (.of true))) 0]
+  | .of false => [.primitive (root (.ground (.of false))) 1]
+  | .mul l r => groundDefinitions l ++ groundDefinitions r ++
+      [.pair (root (.ground (.mul l r))) (root (.ground l)) (root (.ground r))]
+
+/-- Every occurrence of the same expression reuses the same name. -/
+def definitions : MixedExpr X → List (Equation (Name X))
+  | .ground g => groundDefinitions g
+  | .residual a x => [.shift (root (.residual a x)) a (.inl x)]
+  | .pair l r => definitions l ++ definitions r ++
+      [.pair (root (.pair l r)) (root l) (root r)]
+def flatten (E : List (MixedExpr X × MixedExpr X)) : List (Equation (Name X)) :=
+  E.flatMap fun e => definitions e.1 ++ definitions e.2 ++ [.same (root e.1) (root e.2)]
+def extend (v : X → Source) : Name X → Source := Sum.elim v (eval v)
+private theorem ground_value (w : Name X → Source) (g : Source)
+    (h : ∀ e ∈ groundDefinitions g, e.Holds w) : w (root (.ground g)) = g := by
+  induction g with
+  | of b =>
+      cases b with
+      | false => exact h (.primitive (root (.ground (.of false))) 1) (by simp [groundDefinitions])
+      | true => exact h (.primitive (root (.ground (.of true))) 0) (by simp [groundDefinitions])
+  | mul l r hl hr =>
+      have left := hl (fun e he => h e (by simp [groundDefinitions, he]))
+      have right := hr (fun e he => h e (by simp [groundDefinitions, he]))
+      have head := h (.pair (root (.ground (.mul l r))) (root (.ground l))
+        (root (.ground r))) (by simp [groundDefinitions])
+      change w (root (.ground (.mul l r))) = .mul _ _ at head
+      simpa only [left, right] using head
+private theorem definition_value (w : Name X → Source) (e : MixedExpr X) (h : ∀ q ∈ definitions e, q.Holds w) :
+    w (root e) = eval (fun x => w (.inl x)) e := by
+  induction e with
+  | ground g => exact ground_value w g h
+  | residual a x => exact h (.shift (root (.residual a x)) a (.inl x)) (by simp [definitions])
+  | pair l r hl hr =>
+      have left := hl (fun q hq => h q (by simp [definitions, hq]))
+      have right := hr (fun q hq => h q (by simp [definitions, hq]))
+      have head := h (.pair (root (.pair l r)) (root l) (root r))
+        (by simp [definitions])
+      change w (root (.pair l r)) = .mul _ _ at head
+      simpa only [left, right, eval] using head
+private theorem ground_definitions_hold (v : X → Source) (g : Source) : ∀ q ∈ groundDefinitions g, q.Holds (extend v) := by
+  induction g with
+  | of b => cases b <;> simp [groundDefinitions, Equation.Holds, extend, root, eval, expand,
+      GenealogicalFiberTransport.substitution]
+  | mul l r hl hr =>
+      intro q hq
+      simp only [groundDefinitions, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hq
+      rcases hq with (hq | hq) | rfl
+      · exact hl q hq
+      · exact hr q hq
+      · rfl
+private theorem definitions_hold (v : X → Source) (e : MixedExpr X) : ∀ q ∈ definitions e, q.Holds (extend v) := by
+  induction e with
+  | ground g => exact ground_definitions_hold v g
+  | residual a x =>
+      intro q hq
+      simp only [definitions, List.mem_singleton] at hq
+      subst q
+      rfl
+  | pair l r hl hr =>
+      intro q hq
+      simp only [definitions, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hq
+      rcases hq with (hq | hq) | rfl
+      · exact hl q hq
+      · exact hr q hq
+      · rfl
+
+/-- Lowering preserves the same original assignment, including unused inputs. -/
+theorem flatten_exact (E : List (MixedExpr X × MixedExpr X)) (v : X → Source) : (∀ e ∈ E, eval v e.1 = eval v e.2) ↔

+  · intro h q hq
+    obtain ⟨e, he, hq⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hq
+    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hq
+    rcases hq with (hq | hq) | rfl
+    · exact definitions_hold v e.1 q hq
+    · exact definitions_hold v e.2 q hq
+    · exact h e he
+  · intro h e he
+    exact h (.same (root e.1) (root e.2))

+
+/-- The actual finite branch list is constructed directly from the original expression list. -/
+theorem expression_branch_exact (E : List (MixedExpr X × MixedExpr X)) (v : X → Source) :

+  exact NativePositiveBranchReduction.branches_exact (flatten E) (extend v)

+    ∀ e ∈ E, eval (fun x => w (.inl x)) e.1 = eval (fun x => w (.inl x)) e.2 := by

+  have sub (q : Equation (Name X)) (hq : q ∈ definitions e.1 ++ definitions e.2 ++
+      [.same (root e.1) (root e.2)]) := h q (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨e, he, hq⟩)
+  have left := definition_value w e.1 (fun q hq => sub q (by simp [hq]))
+  have right := definition_value w e.2 (fun q hq => sub q (by simp [hq]))
+  have eq := sub (.same (root e.1) (root e.2)) (by simp)
+  exact left.symm.trans (eq.trans right)
+private theorem origins (E : List (Equation X)) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (h : B ∈ NativePositiveBranchReduction.branches E) : B.map BranchEquation.origin = E := by

+  | nil =>
+      simp only [NativePositiveBranchReduction.branches, List.mem_singleton] at h
+      subst B
+      rfl
+  | cons e E ih =>
+      obtain ⟨b, hb, rest⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp h
+      obtain ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp rest
+      simp only [List.map_cons, NativePositiveBranchReduction.choices_origin e b hb, ih B hB]
+
+/-- Arbitrary ambient branch solutions expand to solutions of the original expressions.
+There is no normality, shape separation, injectivity, or size hypothesis. -/
+theorem flatten_expansion_sound (E : List (MixedExpr X × MixedExpr X)) (B : List (BranchEquation (Name X)))

+    ∀ e ∈ E, eval (fun x => expand (u (.inl x))) e.1 = eval (fun x => expand (u (.inl x))) e.2 := by
+  apply flatten_sound E (fun x => expand (u x))
+  intro q hq
+  rw [← origins _ _ hB] at hq
+  obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq
+  exact NativePositiveBranchReduction.branch_sound u b (hu b hb)
+deriving instance DecidableEq for NativePrefixIdentityReflection.MixedExpr

+/-- Every name read by a lowered equation, with repetitions retained. -/
+def equationNames : Equation X → List X
+  | .primitive x _ => [x]
+  | .shift x _ y | .same x y => [x,y]
+  | .pair x y z => [x,y,z]
+
+/-- Include the entire declared tuple before adding auxiliary equation names. -/
+def nameSupport {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) : List (Name (Fin d)) :=
+  ((List.finRange d).map Sum.inl ++ (flatten E).flatMap equationNames).dedup
+abbrev FiniteName {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) :=
+  {x : Name (Fin d) // x ∈ nameSupport E}
+
+/-- The original tuple embeds even when its components never occur in E. -/
+def inputName {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) (i : Fin d) : FiniteName E :=
+  ⟨.inl i, by simp [nameSupport]⟩
+
+/-- A computable presentation obtained from the actual deduplicated finite list. -/
+def namePresentation {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) :
+    NativeTermUnification.Presentation (FiniteName E) :=
+  (NativeTermUnification.finPresentation (nameSupport E).length).transport
+    (List.Nodup.getEquiv (nameSupport E) (List.nodup_dedup _)).symm
+private theorem equation_supported {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d)))
+    (e : Equation (Name (Fin d))) (he : e ∈ flatten E)
+    (x : Name (Fin d)) (hx : x ∈ equationNames e) : x ∈ nameSupport E := by
+  simp only [nameSupport, List.mem_dedup, List.mem_append]
+  exact Or.inr (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨e,he,hx⟩)
+private def restrictEquation {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) : (e : Equation (Name (Fin d))) →
+      (∀ x ∈ equationNames e, x ∈ nameSupport E) → Equation (FiniteName E)
+  | .primitive x a, h => .primitive ⟨x,h x (by simp [equationNames])⟩ a
+  | .shift x a y, h => .shift ⟨x,h x (by simp [equationNames])⟩ a
+      ⟨y,h y (by simp [equationNames])⟩
+  | .pair x y z, h => .pair ⟨x,h x (by simp [equationNames])⟩
+      ⟨y,h y (by simp [equationNames])⟩ ⟨z,h z (by simp [equationNames])⟩
+  | .same x y, h => .same ⟨x,h x (by simp [equationNames])⟩
+      ⟨y,h y (by simp [equationNames])⟩
+
+/-- Reindex every actual lowered equation, retaining all repetitions. -/
+def finiteEquations {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) : List (Equation (FiniteName E)) :=
+  (flatten E).attach.map fun e => restrictEquation E e.val (equation_supported E e.val e.property)
+def finiteExtend {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d)))
+    (v : Fin d → Source) : FiniteName E → Source := fun x => extend v x.val
+private theorem restrictEquation_holds {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d)))
+    (e : Equation (Name (Fin d))) (h : ∀ x ∈ equationNames e, x ∈ nameSupport E) (w : Name (Fin d) → Source) :
+    (restrictEquation E e h).Holds (fun x => w x.val) ↔ e.Holds w := by
+  cases e <;> rfl
+private theorem finite_lowering_exact {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) (v : Fin d → Source) :
+    (∀ e ∈ E, eval v e.1 = eval v e.2) ↔ ∀ q ∈ finiteEquations E, q.Holds (finiteExtend E v) := by
+  rw [flatten_exact E v]
+  constructor
+  · intro h q hq
+    obtain ⟨e,he,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq
+    exact (restrictEquation_holds E e.val _ (extend v)).mpr (h e.val e.property)
+  · intro h e he
+    exact (restrictEquation_holds E e _ (extend v)).mp
+      (h _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨⟨e,he⟩,by simp,rfl⟩))
+
+/-- The actual finite named syntax selects branches and a total successful MGU.
+The factorization includes every name and hence every declared output component. -/
+private theorem finite_expression_reduction {d : Nat}
+    (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) (v : Fin d → Source) : (∀ e ∈ E, eval v e.1 = eval v e.2) ↔
+      ∃ B ∈ NativePositiveBranchReduction.branches (finiteEquations E),
+        (∀ x, NativeFiniteNormalInversion.Normal (encode (finiteExtend E v x))) ∧
+        (∀ b ∈ B, b.Holds (fun x => encode (finiteExtend E v x))) ∧ ∃ S : Lambda.SubstInfo,
+          (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.encodeEquations (namePresentation E)
+            (NativePositiveBranchReduction.shapeEquations B)).unify Lambda.SubstInfo.empty = .ok S ∧
+          (∀ x, NativeTermUnification.evaluate (fun y => NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape (encode (finiteExtend E v y)))
+            (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.action (namePresentation E) S x) =
+              NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape (encode (finiteExtend E v x))) := by
+  rw [finite_lowering_exact E v]
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    obtain ⟨B,hB,hn,hb,S,hok,hfactor,_,_⟩ :=
+      (NativePositiveBranchReduction.native_branch_reduction
+        (namePresentation E) (finiteEquations E) (finiteExtend E v)).mp h
+    exact ⟨B,hB,hn,hb,S,hok,hfactor⟩
+  · rintro ⟨B,hB,_,hb,S,hok,hfactor⟩
+    exact (NativePositiveBranchReduction.branches_exact _ _).mpr ⟨B,hB,hb⟩
+
+/-- Finite affine rank atoms; all coefficients are integral. -/
+inductive Scalar (k : Nat) where
+  | constant : Nat → Scalar k
+  | parameter : Fin k → Nat → Scalar k
+def Scalar.value {k : Nat} (n : Fin k → Nat) : Scalar k → Nat
+  | .constant c => c
+  | .parameter i a => n i + a
+
+/-- A block is an unrestricted native parameter with a fixed natural offset. -/
+inductive Pattern (k m : Nat) where
+  | scalar : Scalar k → Pattern k m
+  | block : Fin m → Nat → Pattern k m
+  | pair : Pattern k m → Pattern k m → Pattern k m
+
+/-- The decoration has exactly the leaves of the supplied free shape.
+An explicit leaf carries a scalar; a residual occurrence carries its native sort and offset. -/
+def Decoration (k m : Nat) : NativeTermUnification.Term X → Type
+  | .of (.inl _) => Scalar k
+  | .of (.inr _) => Fin m × Nat
+  | .mul l r => Decoration k m l × Decoration k m r
+
+/-- Assemble every original and auxiliary name by recursion on its actual free-shape term. -/
+def assemble {k m : Nat} : (s : NativeTermUnification.Term X) → Decoration k m s → Pattern k m
+  | .of (.inl _), r => .scalar r
+  | .of (.inr _), b => .block b.1 b.2
+  | .mul l r, d => .pair (assemble l d.1) (assemble r d.2)
+def Pattern.code {k m : Nat} (n : Fin k → Nat) (z : Fin m → Source) : Pattern k m → Code
+  | .scalar r => .of (r.value n)
+  | .block i a => shiftCode a (encode (z i))
+  | .pair l r => .mul (l.code n z) (r.code n z)
+def Pattern.template {k m : Nat} : Pattern k m → RankedExpr k m
+  | .scalar (.constant c) => .ground (expand (.of c))
+  | .scalar (.parameter i a) => .residual a (.inl i)
+  | .block i a => .residual a (.inr i)
+  | .pair l r => .pair l.template r.template
+private theorem pattern_expansion {k m : Nat} (n : Fin k → Nat) (z : Fin m → Source)
+    (t : Pattern k m) : expand (t.code n z) = rankedEval n z t.template := by
+  induction t with
+  | scalar r =>
+      cases r with
+      | constant c => rfl
+      | parameter i a =>
+          change substitution^[n i + a] (.of true) =
+            substitution^[a] (substitution^[n i] (.of true))
+          rw [Nat.add_comm (n i) a, Function.iterate_add_apply]
+  | block i a =>
+      change expand (shiftCode a (encode (z i))) = substitution^[a] (z i)
+      rw [NativeFiniteNormalInversion.shift_expand, (NativeFiniteNormalInversion.encode_law _).2]
+  | pair l r hl hr => exact congrArg₂ FreeMagma.mul hl hr
+
+/-- Each successful guard is a conjunction of affine integer equalities in n alone. -/
+abbrev Guard (k : Nat) := List (Scalar k × Scalar k)
+def Guard.Holds {k : Nat} (g : Guard k) (n : Fin k → Nat) : Prop :=
+  ∀ e ∈ g, (e.1.value n : Int) = (e.2.value n : Int)
+
+/-- Compare finite decorated shapes; distinct sorts remain independent. -/
+def compare {k m : Nat} : Pattern k m → Pattern k m → Option (Guard k)
+  | .scalar r, .scalar s => some [(r,s)]
+  | .block i a, .block j b => if i = j ∧ a = b then some [] else none
+  | .pair l r, .pair s t => do
+      let a ← compare l s
+      let b ← compare r t
+      pure (a ++ b)
+  | _, _ => none
+private theorem compare_sound {k m : Nat} (A C : Pattern k m) (g : Guard k)
+    (hg : compare A C = some g) (n : Fin k → Nat) (hn : g.Holds n) (z : Fin m → Source) : A.code n z = C.code n z := by
+  induction A generalizing C g with
+  | scalar a =>
+      cases C with
+      | scalar c =>
+          have eq : [(a,c)] = g := Option.some.inj hg
+          subst g
+          have h := hn (a,c) (by simp)
+          exact congrArg FreeMagma.of (Int.ofNat_inj.mp h)
+      | block i b => cases hg
+      | pair l r => cases hg
+  | block i a =>
+      cases C with
+      | scalar c => cases hg
+      | pair l r => cases hg
+      | block j b =>
+          by_cases h : i = j ∧ a = b
+          · rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; rfl
+          · simp [compare, h] at hg
+  | pair l r hl hr =>
+      cases C with
+      | scalar c => cases hg
+      | block j b => cases hg
+      | pair s t =>
+          change ((compare l s).bind fun a =>
+            (compare r t).bind fun b => some (a ++ b)) = some g at hg
+          simp only [Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq] at hg
+          obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, eq⟩ := hg
+          subst g
+          exact congrArg₂ FreeMagma.mul
+            (hl s a ha (fun e he => hn e (List.mem_append_left _ he)))
+            (hr t b hb (fun e he => hn e (List.mem_append_right _ he)))
+
+/-- Translation is performed on the finite syntax, before native parameters are filled. -/
+def Scalar.shift {k : Nat} (a : Nat) : Scalar k → Scalar k
+  | .constant c => .constant (c + a)
+  | .parameter i c => .parameter i (c + a)
+def Pattern.shift {k m : Nat} (a : Nat) : Pattern k m → Pattern k m
+  | .scalar r => .scalar (r.shift a)
+  | .block i b => .block i (a + b)
+  | .pair l r => .pair (l.shift a) (r.shift a)
+private theorem shift_code {k m : Nat} (a : Nat) (t : Pattern k m) (n : Fin k → Nat) (z : Fin m → Source) :
+    (t.shift a).code n z = shiftCode a (t.code n z) := by
+  induction t with
+  | scalar r => cases r <;> simp [Pattern.shift, Scalar.shift, Pattern.code,
+      Scalar.value, shiftCode, Nat.add_assoc]
+  | block i b =>
+      exact (NativePositiveBranchReduction.shift_add a b (encode (z i))).symm
+  | pair l r hl hr => exact congrArg₂ FreeMagma.mul hl hr
+
+/-- Collapse ranks are explicit natural parameters, shared across its three comparisons. -/
+def branchComparisons {k m : Nat} (t : X → Pattern k m) (c : BranchEquation X → Scalar k) (b : BranchEquation X) :
+    List (Pattern k m × Pattern k m) :=
+  match b with
+  | .primitive x a => [(t x, .scalar (.constant a))]
+  | .shift x a y => [(t x, (t y).shift a)]
+  | .ordinary x y z => [(t x, .pair (t y) (t z))]
+  | .same x y => [(t x, t y)]
+  | .collapse x y z =>
+      [(t y, .scalar ((c b).shift 1)),
+       (t z, .scalar (c b)),
+       (t x, .scalar ((c b).shift 2))]
+def collect {k m : Nat} : List (Pattern k m × Pattern k m) → Option (Guard k)
+  | [] => some []
+  | (a,b) :: rest => do
+      let g ← compare a b
+      let h ← collect rest
+      pure (g ++ h)
+private theorem collect_sound {k m : Nat} (L : List (Pattern k m × Pattern k m))
+    (g : Guard k) (hg : collect L = some g) (n : Fin k → Nat) (hn : g.Holds n)
+    (z : Fin m → Source) : ∀ p ∈ L, p.1.code n z = p.2.code n z := by
+  induction L generalizing g with
+  | nil => intro p hp; cases hp
+  | cons p L ih =>
+      change ((compare p.1 p.2).bind fun a =>
+        (collect L).bind fun b => some (a ++ b)) = some g at hg
+      simp only [Option.bind_eq_some_iff, Option.some.injEq] at hg
+      obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := hg
+      intro q hq
+      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with rfl | hq
+      · exact compare_sound q.1 q.2 a ha n
+          (fun e he => hn e (List.mem_append_left _ he)) z
+      · exact ih b hb (fun e he => hn e (List.mem_append_right _ he)) q hq
+private theorem comparisons_branch {k m : Nat} (t : X → Pattern k m) (c : BranchEquation X → Scalar k) (b : BranchEquation X)
+    (n : Fin k → Nat) (z : Fin m → Source) (h : ∀ p ∈ branchComparisons t c b, p.1.code n z = p.2.code n z) :
+    b.Holds (fun x => (t x).code n z) := by
+  cases b with
+  | primitive x a => exact h _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)
+  | shift x a y =>
+      have eq := h _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)
+      exact eq.trans (shift_code a (t y) n z)
+  | ordinary x y z => exact h _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)
+  | same x y => exact h _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)
+  | collapse x y w =>
+      have scalar_shift (r : Scalar k) (a : Nat) :
+          (r.shift a).value n = r.value n + a := by
+        cases r <;> simp [Scalar.shift, Scalar.value, Nat.add_assoc]
+      refine ⟨(c (.collapse x y w)).value n, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+      · simpa only [Pattern.code, scalar_shift] using
+          h (t y, .scalar ((c (.collapse x y w)).shift 1)) (by simp [branchComparisons])
+      · exact h (t w, .scalar (c (.collapse x y w))) (by simp [branchComparisons])
+      · simpa only [Pattern.code, scalar_shift] using
+          h (t x, .scalar ((c (.collapse x y w)).shift 2)) (by simp [branchComparisons])
+
+/-- Successful finite comparison extraction yields an image sound for every native filling.
+The arithmetic domain depends only on natural scalar parameters. -/
+theorem guarded_mixed_sound {k m : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr X × MixedExpr X)) (B : List (BranchEquation (Name X)))
+    (hB : B ∈ NativePositiveBranchReduction.branches (flatten E)) (s : Name X → NativeTermUnification.Term (Name X))
+    (d : ∀ x, Decoration k m (s x)) (c : BranchEquation (Name X) → Scalar k) (g : Guard k)
+    (hg : collect (B.flatMap (branchComparisons (fun x => assemble (s x) (d x)) c)) = some g)
+    (n : Fin k → Nat) (hn : g.Holds n) (z : Fin m → Source) :
+    ∀ e ∈ E, eval (fun x => rankedEval n z (assemble (s (.inl x)) (d (.inl x))).template) e.1 =
+      eval (fun x => rankedEval n z (assemble (s (.inl x)) (d (.inl x))).template) e.2 := by
+  let t : Name X → Pattern k m := fun x => assemble (s x) (d x)
+  have comparisons := collect_sound _ g hg n hn z
+  have branch : ∀ b ∈ B, b.Holds (fun x => (t x).code n z) := by
+    intro b hb
+    apply comparisons_branch t c b n z
+    intro p hp
+    exact comparisons p (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨b,hb,hp⟩)
+  have sound := flatten_expansion_sound E B hB (fun x => (t x).code n z) branch
+  simpa only [pattern_expansion] using sound
+
+/-- Addresses of all explicit primitive leaves of the actual free shape. -/
+def scalarAddresses : NativeTermUnification.Term X → List (List Bool)
+  | .of (.inl _) => [[]]
+  | .of (.inr _) => []
+  | .mul l r => (scalarAddresses l).map (false :: ·) ++
+      (scalarAddresses r).map (true :: ·)
+
+/-- Read an actual primitive rank; the fallback is excluded at extracted scalar sites. -/
+def rankAt (C : Code) (q : List Bool) : Nat :=
+  match NativePositiveImageCover.subtree C q with
+  | some (.of r) => r
+  | _ => 0
+private theorem scalar_site_actual (t : NativeTermUnification.Term X) (v : X → Source) (C : Code)
+    (h : NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape C = NativeTermUnification.evaluate v t)
+    (q : List Bool) (hq : q ∈ scalarAddresses t) : NativePositiveImageCover.subtree C q = some (.of (rankAt C q)) := by
+  induction t generalizing C q with
+  | of a =>
+      cases a with
+      | inr x => simp [scalarAddresses] at hq
+      | inl b =>
+          simp only [scalarAddresses, List.mem_singleton] at hq
+          subst q
+          cases C with
+          | of r => rfl
+          | mul l r => cases h
+  | mul l r hl hr =>
+      cases C with
+      | of n => cases h
+      | mul A B =>
+          change FreeMagma.mul (NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape A)
+            (NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape B) =
+            FreeMagma.mul (NativeTermUnification.evaluate v l)
+              (NativeTermUnification.evaluate v r) at h
+          have hh : NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape A = NativeTermUnification.evaluate v l ∧
+              NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape B = NativeTermUnification.evaluate v r := by
+            injection h with hleft hright
+            exact ⟨hleft,hright⟩
+          simp only [scalarAddresses, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at hq
+          rcases hq with ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ | ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩
+          · exact hl A hh.1 q hq
+          · exact hr B hh.2 q hq
+
+/-- Scalar coordinates remember the name and address, or all three collapse names. -/
+inductive RankSlot (X : Type) where
+  | explicit : X → List Bool → RankSlot X
+  | collapse : X → X → X → RankSlot X
+  deriving DecidableEq
+
+/-- Enumerate every named explicit leaf and each occurrence of a collapse constraint. -/
+def rankSlots (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X)) : List (RankSlot X) :=
+  (p.enumeration.flatMap fun x => (scalarAddresses (s x)).map (RankSlot.explicit x)) ++
+    B.flatMap (fun b => match b with
+      | .collapse z x y => [.collapse z x y]
+      | _ => [])
+def RankSlot.value (u : X → Code) : RankSlot X → Nat
+  | .explicit x q => rankAt (u x) q
+  | .collapse _ _ y => rankAt (u y) []
+
+/-- The finite natural tuple is read from the same actual canonical assignment. -/
+def rankParameters (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (u : X → Code) : Fin (rankSlots p s B).length → Nat :=
+  fun i => ((rankSlots p s B).get i).value u
+
+/-- A collapse coordinate retains r+1, r and r+2 simultaneously. -/
+def RankSlot.Correct (u : X → Code) : RankSlot X → Nat → Prop
+  | .explicit x q, r => NativePositiveImageCover.subtree (u x) q = some (.of r)
+  | .collapse z x y, r => u x = .of (r+1) ∧ u y = .of r ∧ u z = .of (r+2)
+private theorem rank_slots_actual (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X)) (u : X → Code)
+    (hs : ∀ x, NativeTermUnification.evaluate (fun y => NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape (u y)) (s x) =
+        NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape (u x)) (hb : ∀ b ∈ B, b.Holds u) (i : Fin (rankSlots p s B).length) :
+    ((rankSlots p s B).get i).Correct u (rankParameters p s B u i) := by
+  have hi := List.get_mem (rankSlots p s B) i
+  simp only [rankParameters]
+  generalize he : (rankSlots p s B).get i = a at hi ⊢
+  change a.Correct u (a.value u)
+  simp only [rankSlots, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map] at hi
+  rcases hi with ⟨x,hx,q,hq,rfl⟩ | ⟨b,hb',ha⟩
+  · exact scalar_site_actual (s x) _ (u x) (hs x).symm q hq
+  · cases b <;> simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at ha
+    rename_i z x y
+    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at ha
+    rw [ha]
+    obtain ⟨r,hx,hy,hz⟩ := hb (.collapse z x y) hb'
+    simpa only [RankSlot.Correct, RankSlot.value, rankAt, hy,
+      NativePositiveImageCover.subtree] using And.intro hx (And.intro hy hz)
+
+/-- Every original solution automatically yields a finite total MGU and a natural
+coordinate for every explicit shape leaf and collapse constraint of that branch. -/
+theorem finite_rank_extraction {d : Nat} (E : List (MixedExpr (Fin d) × MixedExpr (Fin d))) (v : Fin d → Source)
+    (hv : ∀ e ∈ E, eval v e.1 = eval v e.2) : (∀ i : Fin d, finiteExtend E v (inputName E i) = v i) ∧
+    ∃ B ∈ NativePositiveBranchReduction.branches (finiteEquations E),
+      (∀ b ∈ B, b.Holds (fun x => encode (finiteExtend E v x))) ∧ ∃ S : Lambda.SubstInfo,
+        (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.encodeEquations (namePresentation E)
+          (NativePositiveBranchReduction.shapeEquations B)).unify Lambda.SubstInfo.empty = .ok S ∧
+        (∀ x, NativeTermUnification.evaluate (fun y => NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape (encode (finiteExtend E v y)))
+          (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.action (namePresentation E) S x) =
+            NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape (encode (finiteExtend E v x))) ∧ (∀ i : Fin (rankSlots (namePresentation E)
+            (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.action (namePresentation E) S) B).length, ((rankSlots (namePresentation E)
+            (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.action (namePresentation E) S) B).get i).Correct
+              (fun x => encode (finiteExtend E v x)) (rankParameters (namePresentation E)
+                (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.action (namePresentation E) S) B (fun x => encode (finiteExtend E v x)) i)) := by
+  refine ⟨fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
+  obtain ⟨B,hB,_,hb,S,hok,hs⟩ := (finite_expression_reduction E v).mp hv
+  exact ⟨B,hB,hb,S,hok,hs,rank_slots_actual (namePresentation E)
+    (NativeGroundSolutionSpace.action (namePresentation E) S) B
+    (fun x => encode (finiteExtend E v x)) hs hb⟩
+
+/-- A scalar slot is indexed in the finite list; absence has a total fallback,
+which is excluded at every actual explicit leaf and selected collapse. -/
+def slotScalar [DecidableEq X] (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (a : RankSlot X) : Scalar (rankSlots p s B).length :=
+  if h : a ∈ rankSlots p s B then
+    .parameter ⟨(rankSlots p s B).idxOf a, List.idxOf_lt_length_iff.mpr h⟩ 0
+  else .constant 0
+private theorem slotScalar_value [DecidableEq X] (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (u : X → Code) (a : RankSlot X) (ha : a ∈ rankSlots p s B) :
+    (slotScalar p s B a).value (rankParameters p s B u) = a.value u := by
+  simp [slotScalar, ha, Scalar.value, rankParameters]
+
+/-- Every residual occurrence, including those in isolated unused outputs,
+is retained by the existing total-MGU occurrence enumeration. -/
+abbrev residualOccurrences (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) := NativePositiveImageCover.occurrenceVertices p s
+private theorem subtree_append {A : Type} (t : FreeMagma A) (q r : List Bool) : NativePositiveImageCover.subtree t (q ++ r) =
+      (NativePositiveImageCover.subtree t q).bind (fun u => NativePositiveImageCover.subtree u r) := by
+  induction q generalizing t with
+  | nil => simp [NativePositiveImageCover.subtree]
+  | cons b q ih =>
+      cases t with
+      | of a => rfl
+      | mul l u => cases b <;> exact ih _
+
+/-- Traverse the actual shape, assigning its automatic scalar coordinates.
+The block map is required only at actual residual leaves, so absent residuals
+permit m=0 without a nonexistent selector. -/
+def decorateAt [DecidableEq X] {m : Nat} (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (blocks : (o : NativePositiveImageCover.Occurrence X) → NativePositiveImageCover.IsOccurrence s o → Fin m × Nat)
+    (x : X) (q : List Bool) : (t : NativeTermUnification.Term X) → NativePositiveImageCover.subtree (s x) q = some t →
+      Decoration (rankSlots p s B).length m t
+  | .of (.inl _), _ => slotScalar p s B (.explicit x q)
+  | .of (.inr y), h => blocks (x,q,y) h
+  | .mul l r, h =>
+      (decorateAt p s B blocks x (q ++ [false]) l (by rw [subtree_append,h]; simp [NativePositiveImageCover.subtree]),
+       decorateAt p s B blocks x (q ++ [true]) r (by rw [subtree_append,h]; simp [NativePositiveImageCover.subtree]))
+def automaticDecoration [DecidableEq X] {m : Nat}
+    (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X) (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X))
+    (blocks : (o : NativePositiveImageCover.Occurrence X) →
+      NativePositiveImageCover.IsOccurrence s o → Fin m × Nat) (x : X) :
+    Decoration (rankSlots p s B).length m (s x) := decorateAt p s B blocks x [] (s x) (by simp [NativePositiveImageCover.subtree])
+
+/-- Collapse coordinates are drawn from the same finite tuple as explicit ranks. -/
+def automaticCollapse [DecidableEq X] (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)
+    (s : X → NativeTermUnification.Term X) (B : List (BranchEquation X)) : BranchEquation X → Scalar (rankSlots p s B).length
+  | .collapse z x y => slotScalar p s B (.collapse z x y)
+  | _ => .constant 0
+private theorem explicit_slot_mem (p : NativeTermUnification.Presentation X)

+def Pattern.frame {k m : Nat} : Pattern k m → FreeMagma Bool

+  | .block _ _ => .of false
+  | .pair l r => .mul l.frame r.frame

+/-- Residual compatibility has no scalar equations. It only asks that matching
+block leaves use the same sort and fixed offset. -/
+def blockCompatible {k m : Nat} : Pattern k m → Pattern k m → Prop
+  | .block i a, .block j b => i = j ∧ a = b
+  | .pair l r, .pair u v => blockCompatible l u ∧ blockCompatible r v
+  | _, _ => True

+/-- Agreement checks the actual scalar leaves and pair constructors, while
+leaving every residual block untouched for the separate offset problem. -/
+def Pattern.Agrees {k m : Nat} (n : Fin k → Nat) : Pattern k m → Code → Prop
+  | .scalar a, C => C = .of (a.value n)
+  | .block _ _, _ => True

+private theorem scalar_address_mem (t : NativeTermUnification.Term X) (q : List Bool)

+  induction q generalizing t with
+  | nil =>
+      simp only [NativePositiveImageCover.subtree, Option.some.injEq] at h
+      subst t
+      simp [scalarAddresses]
+  | cons d q ih =>
+      cases t with
+      | of a => cases h
+      | mul l r =>
+          cases d
+          · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨q,ih l h,rfl⟩)

+    (q : List Bool) (ht : NativePositiveImageCover.subtree (s x) q = some t)

+      (fun y => NativePositiveBranchReduction.shape (u y)) t) :

+    (assemble (s x) (automaticDecoration p s B blocks x)).Agrees (rankParameters p s B u) (u x) :=

+    (t.shift a).Agrees n (shiftCode a C) := by

+  induction A generalizing C U with
+  | scalar a =>

+      | scalar b =>
+          have eq : a.value n = b.value n := by
+            have h := hA.symm.trans hC

+          intro e he
+          simp only [List.mem_singleton] at he

+          dsimp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd]
+          exact congrArg Int.ofNat eq
+      | block i b => cases hf
+      | pair l r => cases hf
+  | block i a =>
+      cases C with
+      | scalar b => cases hf
+      | pair l r => cases hf
+      | block j b =>

+      | scalar b => cases hf

+          intro e he
+          rcases List.mem_append.mp he with he | he
+          · exact hn e he
+          · exact hm e he

+    (blocks : (o : NativePositiveImageCover.Occurrence X) → NativePositiveImageCover.IsOccurrence s o → Fin m × Nat)

+      ∃ C, e.1.Agrees (rankParameters p s B u) C ∧ e.2.Agrees (rankParameters p s B u) C := by

+  have hold := hb b hmem

+  | primitive x a =>
+      intro e he
+      simp only [branchComparisons,List.mem_singleton] at he
+      subst e
+      dsimp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd]
+      exact ⟨u x,actual x,hold⟩
+  | shift x a y =>
+      intro e he
+      simp only [branchComparisons,List.mem_singleton] at he
+      subst e

+      subst e
+      dsimp only [Prod.fst,Prod.snd]
+      exact ⟨u x,actual x,u y,u z,hold,actual y,actual z⟩
+  | same x y =>
+      intro e he
+      simp only [branchComparisons,List.mem_singleton] at he
+      subst e

+  induction A generalizing C g with

+      | scalar b => trivial
+      | pair l r => trivial
+      | block j b =>

+          by_contra hn
+          simp [hn] at h

+      | scalar b => trivial

+    (∃ g, collect L = some g ∧ g.Holds n) ↔ ∀ e ∈ L, blockCompatible e.1 e.2 := by
+  induction L with
+  | nil => simp [collect,Guard.Holds]
+  | cons e L ih =>
+      constructor
+      · rintro ⟨g,hg,hng⟩
+        change ((compare e.1 e.2).bind fun a =>
+          (collect L).bind fun b => some (a ++ b)) = some g at hg
+        simp only [Option.bind_eq_some_iff,Option.some.injEq] at hg
+        obtain ⟨a,ha',b,hb,rfl⟩ := hg
+        intro f hf'

+        · exact compare_blocks _ _ a ha'
+        · have hnb : b.Holds n := fun q hq => hng q (List.mem_append_right _ hq)

+            (fun q hq => ha q (by simp [hq]))).mp ⟨b,hb,hnb⟩ f hf'

+        intro q hq
+        rcases List.mem_append.mp hq with h | h

+        · exact hnb q h

+**证明。** 设 $n\le k$ 且 $h$ 是任何实际停止历史。定理 10.4 给出同一完整历史纤维中的秩一来源 $S=c\ell$。所以该纤维不可能全部由秩二来源组成；因此定义 10.5 的任何元素都满足 $n\ge k+1$，从而 $C_k\ge k+1$。
+
+非空性和相反不等式只复用本卷定理 9.7、命题 9.8 的已发表结论，不重述它们的扫描证明或见证构造。执行其固定词 $L_0N^{k-1}$，初读计入共 $k+1$ 次读数；命题 9.8 给出一个实际秩二来源，其扫描数据使 (9.8) 失败，定理 9.7 的第一项断言该完整历史纤维在 $\mathcal M_k$ 中只能包含秩二来源。令协议先执行这个固定词，在末读后当且仅当 (9.8) 失败输出 $2$；在该实际来源上它停止并满足定义 10.5。因此 $C_k\le k+1$，与下界合并得到 (10.21)。
+
+这里的最小值是“某个实际来源、某个协议、某个停止历史”的达到的最小值；它不声称每个 $k+1$ 读数历史都有秩二证书，也不声称每个秩二来源都可认证，更不提供全域分类或初始矩阵恢复。第 9.5、9.9 的 $k=2$ 等列秩一例外以及附录 K 定义 45.3、定理 45.4 的 $2k-1$ 秩一承诺恢复费用均保持原范围。∎
